code: # Replace with your run directory that contains spm.dat run_dir <- c("../examples/atka", "examples/atka") run_dir <- run_dir[file.exists(run_dir)][1] if (is.na(run_dir)) stop("Could not locate examples/atka") run_dir <- normalizePath(run_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)  set.seed(123)  # ADMB run (requires spm binary) # admb_res <- runSPM(run_dir, run = TRUE, engine = "admb")  # RTMB run rtmb_file <- file.path(run_dir, "spm_detail_rtmb.csv") if (file.exists(rtmb_file)) {   rtmb_res <- utils::read.csv(rtmb_file) } else if (requireNamespace("spmR", quietly = TRUE)) {   rtmb_res <- spmR::runSPM(run_dir, run = TRUE, engine = "rtmb") } else {   stop("Need either an existing spm_detail_rtmb.csv file or an installed spmR package.") }

Max.  ##  181439  181439  181439  181439  181439  181439 if (exists("admb_res")) {   library(ggplot2)   metrics <- c("SSB", "ABC", "OFL", "Catch", "F")   plot_data <- rbind(     transform(admb_res[, metrics], engine = "ADMB"),     transform(rtmb_res[, metrics], engine = "RTMB")   )    plot_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(     plot_data,     cols = all_of(metrics),     names_to = "metric",     values_to = "value"   )    ggplot(plot_long, aes(x = value, color = engine)) +     geom_density() +     facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free") +     labs(x = NULL, y = "Density", color = "Engine") +     theme_minimal() }

title: projak vs spmR
text: projak (Ben Williams, v0.0.0.9000): pure-R package NPFMC projection scenarios (1-7) downstream RTMB assessment; accepts report object input. spmR (Jim Ianelli, v0.2.0): Standard Projection Model wrapper around legacy ADMB spm executable experimental RTMB path; reads .dat inputs (ADMB-style).

title: projak vs spmR
text: projects implement inverse-Gaussian recruitment, different parameterization paths: projak: takes arithmetic harmonic means directly report$recruits. spmR RTMB path: derives CV harmonic--arithmetic ratio, samples recruitment.

what: Tier and Harvest Control Rule Logic
title: projak vs spmR
text: projak includes full get_tier_f() implementation Amendment 56 ramp logic, SSL protection, scenario-specific F rules. spmR RTMB path (runSPM_rtmb) currently stubs scenario loop; SSB, catch, F placeholder means rather forward age-structured projections.

title: projak vs spmR
text: runSPM_rtmb() spmR currently scaffold: recruitment draws implemented, age-structured population dynamics . contrast, projak::project_step() performs full age-structured projection (survival, catch--age, plus-group dynamics, SSB updates).

title: projak vs spmR
text: projak: data.table, tidytable, magrittr spmR: dplyr, ggplot2, ggthemes, patchwork, readr, stringr, tibble, tidyr

title: projak vs spmR
text: projak effectively focused, RTMB-native replacement projection component, complete harvest control rule logic lighter dependencies. spmR remains broader infrastructure (data /O, multi-species SPM workflow, ADMB wrapper, visualization), RTMB path still needs substantial development match projak projection fidelity.
